name: Monkey Minigames
summary: Monkey Minigames (MM) is my second VR, my first being Cyber Monkeys. Gorilla Tag is a great game that has inspired many fan games, including this one, as well as my first game, Cyber Monkeys. The reason I created this game is that I'm a new developer and want to become one full-time. Making a game like this allows me to experiment with different minigames in a fun way for people to enjoy. If you have any ideas, please join the Discord and tell us!
